architecture.mechanism: Binary interactions of precipitates-particulates and ternary interactions of precipitates-particulates-biofouling are the primary drivers of clogging, while root intrusion is a minor factor (<5.0%).
architecture.intervention: Implement pre-filtration and hydraulic flushing protocols to remove precipitates and particulates, thereby preventing the formation of the binary and ternary clogging matrices that facilitate minor root intrusion.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction of overall emitter clogging by over 70% by eliminating the dominant physical and chemical fouling mechanisms, indirectly mitigating root intrusion risks without chemical treatments.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate subsurface drip emitters with identical pre-filtration and flushing in sugarcane fields for 12 months; if clogging rates exceed 30% or root intrusion exceeds 5%, the mechanism is falsified.
